Minor in Applications of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning

minor is open to students pursuing majors; No “mix and match” is allowed; Only 3 credit hours of research; can fulfill the BMED 2400 pre-requisites; must take CS 1301 or an equivalent approved programming language course; At least two courses must be taken outside; grade of C or higher; No course counted towards this minor
